verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a first-party feature to "enable your customers to connect their third-party accounts to your application," which is the core of a user-consented third-party token capability, but the evidence is a single one-line mention. Vault is only encrypted storage, and AuthKit MCP/OAuth covers WorkOS acting as the authorization server, so neither counts as third-party token exchange. Missing for 10: documentation of short-lived token issuance/refresh for third-party APIs, an agent-facing retrieval or exchange flow, per-user consent and scoping details, supported provider list, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
